summary: The scalar inequality and both depth conclusions are proved without mathematical errors or gaps. The complete lattice census and unimodular chart are valid; the restricted closed-halfspace depth is attained with all equality atoms accounted for, including zero-block and all-zero centers. The Gaussian midpoint identity, parity-class estimate, strict theta bound, and original multiplicity sum establish the claimed uniform strict inequality for every Q >= 1 and all admissible parameters. Accepted fact 488f0a583886b5fc applies with the stated unscaled normalization, and its formula (15) gives the asserted logarithmic lower bound at the same center.
